groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Mixed / Neutral
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.804% and the 10Y at 5.307%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has fallen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is +2.94% over five sessions and +3.82% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +0.56% at about $101.14, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (+5/100, 67% confidence, improving ↑). The current balance is semiconductor/AI leaders holding above their earnings AVWAPs on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in the 10Y yield is above the 5.05% headwind threshold at 5.307%. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction. Elevated consolidation risk is reducing conviction in the directional setup.
